title: Automatic camera topology selection
summary: The daemon no longer hardcodes /dev/videoN paths or VID:PID constants. Camera topology is auto-detected at runtime via sysfs USB enumeration, format-GUID classification, and interface-number node pairing. The existing select_camera preference order (configured → enrolled → internal → first IR) is reused through an injectable CameraInventory seam.

production_code_changes.crates/namtor-hwdb/src/pipeline.rs: Added NodePairing struct and Classification::pair() method — deterministic IR/metadata/RGB node pairing by USB interface number
production_code_changes.crates/namtor-camera/src/inventory.rs: New module: CameraInventory trait, DiscoveredCamera, SysfsInventory (production), FakeInventory (test), select_camera_from_inventory() — the inventory seam
production_code_changes.crates/namtor-daemon/src/bin/namtor-daem: Removed hardcoded /dev/video2, /dev/video3, and 3277:0018 constant. Factory now enumerates via CameraInventory, selects via select_camera_from_inventory, and opens the selected device. EmitterGuard stores EmitterCfg for restore-on-drop instead of reloading quirks by hardcoded VID:PID.
Added NAMTOR_CAMERA_DEV env var for admin-configured device path override
